claude_proposed_widenings.name: species_lineage_choice_with_progression
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The trait is one unit whose player chooses one of several lineage branches, and that choice controls multiple later level-gated benefits. Existing SpeciesTraitMechanics only allow a flat passive or activation payload, not a build-time branch that owns later grants.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose a lineage from the Elven Lineages table. You gain the level 1 benefit of that lineage. When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell, as shown on the table.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: level_gated_species_trait_grant
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The later lineage benefits are not always-on from level 1; they unlock at character levels 3 and 5. Current passive species-trait grants have no honest character-level acquisition gate on individual grant atoms.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell, as shown on the table.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access_replaceable_cantrip_on_long_rest
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: High Elf's level-1 cantrip is not a fixed granted spell. It can be swapped for a different Wizard cantrip whenever the character finishes a Long Rest, which is broader than the current static grant_spell_access modes.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace that cantrip with a different cantrip from the Wizard spell list.
